skipped.reason: Terms forbid it: 'Without our express prior written consent you may not copy (whether by printing off onto paper, storing on disk, downloading or in any other way)... any material contained on this website' and 'You are expressly prohibited from: Automated Data Collection: Using bots, crawlers... to access, extract, scrape, or harvest data or content from this website'. No product data collected. kronostar.ru is a parked domain for sale.

Terms: 'Материалы веб-сайта не могут быть скопированы, изменены, воспроизведены, переизданы, загружены на иных носителях... без предварительного письменного разрешения компании KEAS' and materials 'могут использоваться с указанием ссылки на их источник и при условии получения соответствующего предварительного письменного разрешения'. kastamonu.ru redirects here. No product data collected.
Lamarty (Сыктывкарский фанерный завод) site lists only ЛДСП/MFC, edges; no MDF/HDF/ХДФ products found (0 mentions of МДФ/ХДФ/MDF/HDF on catalog/specification pages).
Out of scope per brief (Egger covered by another agent).
Former Russian site now only redirects to ultradecor.com 'find your country' (expired TLS cert); no Russian-language decor names available anywhere — ultradecor.com /ru/ serves English.

notes: Ultradecor (ultradecor.com, current international site; Russian site retired): captured every decor on all 4 decorated MDF/HDF product pages. Unique decor codes / (decor,structure) records: MF MDF (148, 190), Lacquered MDF (Favorit 2.0) (11, 39), Ultra M MDF (Moonlight) (34, 34), LHDF (10, 12). One material record per (decor code, structure code) pair: the site writes e.g. '0164 BS, PE, SU, UG, UM Anthracite' meaning one decor available in several surface codes; decorCode = the 'ID:' value, structureCode = each 2-letter code. On the MF MDF page UG/UM (Ultra Gloss / Ultra Matt, i.e. lacquered) are listed alongside melamine structures — kept as published. Names are English only (no Russian names published anywhere now). 8 Ultra M MDF codes are written on the site with Cyrillic 'С' (С200, С301, С311–С318) while siblings use Latin C (C309...); normalised to Latin 'C' here — flag if exact bytes matter. Sizes/thicknesses are product-wide (sizeBasis range-wide), not per decor: MF MDF 2800x2070, 16/18/19/22/25 mm; Lacquered MDF 2800x2070, 16/18; Ultra M MDF 2800x2070, 16/18; LHDF 2500x2070 + 2800x2070, thickness published as '2.5, 3' — only 3 kept because schema requires integers (2.5 mm also exists). Plain boards: Ultradecor publishes no product article, so decorCode 'RAW' is used for literally unfinished boards (HDF 3 mm 2800x2070 — second size printed '2500 x 207' is a typo and not recorded; MDF Ultra M 16/18 2440x1220 & 2800x2070; MDF Standart ST/L and Special XL/XXL — only densities published, no sizes). Grain: Ultradecor does not classify decors as wood/uni; only MF MDF decors under the 'Color' tab are marked 'none', everything else 'unknown' (tab names Contempo/Standart/Harmony recorded in collection). No 4 mm HDF found at Ultradecor. Kazakhstan producer: Smart Panels / ТОО Mega Smart (Shymkent) publishes a painted-MDF palette PDF with 20 colours x 2 surfaces (HIGH GLOSS, TOUCH SENSE) but NO codes, sizes or thicknesses; decorCode therefore = the published colour name (no code exists), structureCode = surface name. Skipped for terms: Kronospan/Kronostar and Kastamonu (explicit copy/scrape bans). Lamarty has no MDF/HDF. Egger skipped per brief. No edges collected (out of scope; Ultradecor edge bands not listed per decor).
